end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi stated that one bundle represents ten.
They identified eleven as ten and one, and thirteen as ten and three.
They mixed up counting the bundle as one with counting it as ten; no unaided correct attempt was recorded.
Saanvi asked to stop after 0.9 minutes.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and extra loose sticks. Saanvi used the method “ten and one” for 11 and later corrected the bundle-counting mix-up by saying that ten and three makes 13 (correctAfterLastSeen: yes). At home, briefly build 11, 12, and 13 with one group of ten and loose objects, saying “ten and ___” each time.
